headline: Weekend closure keeps Tail low while energy, rates and geopolitical uncertainty sustain high Stress
body: NQ futures are closed for the weekend, so there is no live price path showing persistent mean-reversion failure. Friday ended with the Nasdaq higher and semiconductor strength, while the 10-year Treasury yield held above 5% and WTI settled above $100. Fresh supplementary breadth remained mixed outside semiconductors, keeping Tail low and Stress high.
